metadata.title: Rewound Before the IPO Crash
metadata.subtitle: My co-founder and husband sold our AI core to a rival and framed me for the SEC leak. I blinked back into the boardroom 40 minutes before the bell.

nodes.text: 8:50 AM · The prison jumpsuit vanishes. You’re wearing a crisp white blazer inside the Exchange green room—40 minutes before Tessa and Owen destroy your $800M AI startup.
Babe, breathe! Tessa’s pushing the final v4.2 model weights right now—we’re about to ring the Nasdaq bell!
She isn’t pushing v4.2. She’s uploading our source code to Titan Corp’s bucket.
Owen, the backdoor key worked! Titan’s wire hits our Singapore account at 9:15 AM.

nodes.transcript: [panicked whisper] "Brooke, weird alert on Prod Server 3—an admin using YOUR SSH key is exporting 400GB of model weights!"

nodes.prompt: Tessa smiles across the espresso bar with her laptop open:

options.label: Revoke your SSH key & freeze Prod Server 3
options.player_reply_text: Dev, kill Prod 3’s outbound port NOW and log the MAC address!

options.label: Swap the export with a watermarked poison file

nodes.text: Tessa’s progress bar freezes at 98%. Her manicured fingers stall above the trackpad.
Uh—Brooke? Did you just kick me off the deployment cluster?!
You silently swap the model weights for a corrupted honeypot that pings Titan Corp’s IP the second they open it.
Done! v4.2 is totally synced—let’s head up to the podium!
Owen checks his watch anxiously, clueless that the trap meant for you just reversed.
MAC address matched, Boss—the 400GB theft came straight from Tessa’s MacBook sitting 10 feet from you!

nodes.headline: The Backdoor Closes
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Fake SEC Leak — In your first life, a fake accounting leak hit Bloomberg at 9:10 AM—tanking your stock 70% while Owen shorted it..

nodes.text: 9:02 AM · In your first life, a fake accounting leak hit Bloomberg at 9:10 AM—tanking your stock 70% while Owen shorted it.
Hey, can I borrow your phone to text the PR agency? Mine’s at 2% battery.
No. Last time you used my phone to email forged revenue sheets to a reporter.
Tessa, she won’t hand over her phone—use the cloned SIM in my briefcase!

nodes.transcript: [urgent tone] "Boss, someone just logged into your corporate email from a burner Android inside this very building!"

nodes.prompt: Twenty minutes to the opening bell and the fake leak is queued to send:

options.label: Force-logout all sessions & lock your email
options.player_reply_text: Dev, kill all active tokens and pull the burner’s Wi-Fi triangulation!

options.label: Swap the draft with Owen’s short-trade proof

nodes.text: Owen’s briefcase buzzes with a session-expired alert. Sweat beads along his temple.
Why is the Wi-Fi acting weird?! Let me step into the hall for a second!
You quietly hijack the burner draft—sending the reporter proof of Owen’s secret $15M short position instead.
Wait—why is the Bloomberg reporter texting ME asking about an offshore hedge fund?!
The Exchange floor manager waves you toward the glass balcony. Twelve minutes to liftoff.
Triangulation locked: that burner Android is literally inside Owen’s leather briefcase!

nodes.headline: Twelve Minutes Left
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Singapore Kickback — Right on schedule, Titan Corp wires $5M to Owen and Tessa’s joint Singapore shell—the payoff for sabotaging your IPO..

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Right on schedule, Titan Corp wires $5M to Owen and Tessa’s joint Singapore shell—the payoff for sabotaging your IPO.
Our forensic compliance bot just flagged a $5M cross-border wire linked to Titan Corp and Owen’s personal tax ID!
Send that receipt directly to the SEC observer sitting in the VIP gallery.
Owen, the $5M landed! Once the stock opens flat, we cash out and fly to Zurich!

nodes.transcript: [excited whisper] "The SEC observer just froze the wire and requested the Exchange pause Tessa’s insider share unlock!"

nodes.caption: Cross-border $5M transfer queued from Titan Corp Holdings to Owen & Tessa’s Singapore shell account.

nodes.prompt: Owen puts his arm around your waist for the IPO press photo:

options.label: Step away & ask why Titan wired him $5M
options.player_reply_text: Smile for the cameras, Owen—and explain the $5M from Titan Corp.

options.label: Wait for the bell to expose him on live TV

nodes.text: Owen’s hand drops from your waist as if burned. Photographers keep clicking.
Keep your voice down! That’s—that’s a consulting fee from last year!
You ring the Nasdaq bell to roaring applause—then hand the printed wire receipt to the Exchange general counsel on live camera.
Wait—why are federal marshals walking onto the balcony?!
Your startup opens at +42% above IPO price—while Owen’s secret short position vaporizes $18M in thirty seconds.
Wait—Titan Corp just texted me that the AI weights I sent them are corrupted! Brooke, what did you do?!

nodes.headline: Bell Rings, Empire Burns
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Margin Call Panic — Owen’s broker calls—his leveraged short bet just wiped out his penthouse, his cars, and his hidden trust fund..

nodes.text: 9:40 AM · Owen’s broker calls—his leveraged short bet just wiped out his penthouse, his cars, and his hidden trust fund.
Brooke, issue a temporary trading halt right now or my brokerage liquidates everything we own!
Everything YOU own, Owen. I separated our accounts at 8:55 AM.
Tessa, wire back my half of the Singapore money—I need $4M before 10 AM!

nodes.transcript: [panicking in stairwell] "I can’t touch Singapore—it’s frozen! And Titan’s lawyers are threatening to sue us for fraud!"

nodes.prompt: Owen corners you outside the Exchange elevator:

options.label: Tell him his burner phone is already with SEC
options.player_reply_text: Your briefcase is with federal investigators, Owen. Call a criminal lawyer.

options.label: Trigger the board vote removing Tessa as CTO

nodes.text: Owen lunges for his briefcase—only to see two SEC agents sealing it in an evidence bag.
That’s illegal! I didn’t consent to a search!!
Your board votes 7-0 on Zoom to strip Tessa of CTO access and claw back her 12% unvested equity.
My stock options just vanished from my portal!! Brooke!!
Tessa bolts toward the fire exit—trying to reach the server HQ before Dev locks her physical badge.
Boss! Tessa just hailed a cab straight to our HQ server room—she still has the physical master key!

nodes.headline: Race To Server Room 4
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Kill-Switch Sabotage — Tessa wants to wipe your live training cluster out of spite so your stock crashes before noon..

nodes.text: 10:15 AM · Tessa wants to wipe your live training cluster out of spite so your stock crashes before noon.
She’s inside the building! Badge reader didn’t stop her because she tailgated a delivery guy!
Lock the biometric door to Server Room 4 and keep the cameras rolling.
If I can’t get my $80M payout, nobody gets this company!

nodes.transcript: [keyboards clacking fast] "I locked Server Room 4 remotely—wait, she’s trying to pry the emergency power breaker in the hallway!"

nodes.prompt: You watch Tessa on the live corridor feed raising a fire extinguisher at the breaker:

options.label: Trigger the hallway intercom & warn her
options.player_reply_text: Drop it, Tessa. Every swing is federal felony sabotage on 4K video.

options.label: Switch servers to battery & trap her in the hall

nodes.text: Tessa freezes mid-swing, glaring straight up at the red recording LED.
You stole my life’s work!! I wrote half that codebase!!
You flip the cluster onto isolated UPS backup and lock both magnetic corridor doors until police arrive.
Hey!! The exit doors won’t open!! Let me out!!
Building security and two police officers unlock the corridor door three minutes later.
Cluster uptime is 100%, Boss! Zero data lost—and Tessa’s laptop is in police custody!

nodes.headline: Sabotage Foiled
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Hidden Affair — Forensic decryption of Owen’s briefcase burner reveals something even uglier than corporate treason..

nodes.text: 11:30 AM · Forensic decryption of Owen’s briefcase burner reveals something even uglier than corporate treason.
Uh, Boss... the SEC attorney asked me to send you this chat log from Owen’s burner. It’s personal.
Let me guess—Owen and Tessa bought a villa in Lake Como together last year.
Tessa, once Brooke is indicted for the SEC leak, I’ll file for divorce and claim half her founder shares.

nodes.transcript: [sympathetic voice] "They planned this for 14 months, Brooke. Every ‘late coding sprint’ was a hotel weekend."

nodes.prompt: Owen texts from his lawyer’s office begging you to post his $500K bail:

options.label: Send him the Lake Como deed screenshot
options.player_reply_text: Ask Tessa to bail you out, Owen. Maybe sell your Lake Como villa.

options.label: File fraud-annulment & freeze his marital assets

nodes.text: Owen reads the message and leaves you on seen for the first time in five years.
You went through my private messages?! Fine—see you in family court!
Your divorce counsel files an emergency asset-dissipation freeze—seizing the Lake Como villa paid with stolen startup funds.
You froze my Italian deed too?! I’m completely wiped out!!
At 12:00 PM, Titan Corp’s stock plunges 11% after news breaks of their illegal IP bribery probe.
Wait—Titan Corp’s VP just called our board offering a $30M settlement if we drop the corporate espionage claim!

nodes.headline: The Giant Blinks First
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Titan Counterstrike — Don’t trust Titan Corp’s settlement smile.

nodes.text: 2:10 PM · Don’t trust Titan Corp’s settlement smile. In your first life, they used "settlement talks" to stall while poaching your engineers.
Heads up—three senior ML engineers just got $2M signing offers from Titan recruiters in the last ten minutes!
I expected that. Roll out the employee equity pool we just reclaimed from Tessa.
Tell Titan’s recruiter to grab Dev first—without Dev their inference engine stalls!

nodes.transcript: [grinning in voice note] "Titan just offered me $3M to jump ship. I told them I’d rather work for the CEO who outsmarted Wall Street!"

nodes.prompt: Titan’s VP waits on Zoom expecting you to beg for the $30M settlement:

options.label: Reject $30M & demand $90M plus public apology
options.player_reply_text: Triple the offer and put your VP’s resignation on the table, or see you in federal court.

options.label: Release the honeypot IP trace to tech press

nodes.text: Titan’s VP turns pale on camera as your general counsel uploads the federal injunction.
Their stock just dropped another 9%! Their board is panicking!
Tech media publishes the watermarked IP trace—proving Titan knowingly bought stolen startup code.
Titan’s own CEO just fired the VP and asked to negotiate directly with YOU!
By 3:00 PM, every single engineer on your team signs a 4-year retention pledge.
Wait—security just flagged an empty hallway camera outside our patent vault at 3:05 PM. Someone looped the feed!

nodes.headline: The Looped Corridor
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Vault Intrusion — Someone looped the 14th-floor CCTV to look empty while sneaking into your air-gapped hardware vault..

nodes.text: 3:08 PM · Someone looped the 14th-floor CCTV to look empty while sneaking into your air-gapped hardware vault.
Look at this camera frame—same blinking exit sign pixel for 4 straight minutes! Someone’s inside the vault!
It’s Owen’s bail-bond cousin—a former network contractor. Cut the vault RFID now!
Grab the cold-storage seed drive from Rack 2 and walk out calmly!

nodes.transcript: [rushed tone] "Air-gap alarm triggered! Magnetic deadbolt engaged—whoever is inside can’t leave without your palm print!"

nodes.caption: 14th-Floor Vault Hallway CCTV · 15:08 — frozen empty corridor loop used to mask an active break-in.

nodes.text: [keyboard clatter] "The 14th-floor biometric lock just pinged—someone cloned Owen’s badge to pull the cold-storage drives! Should I lock the elevator shaft right now?"
ALERT: Cloned badge just opened the 14th-floor vault! Someone is pulling the drives—lock the floor now?

nodes.prompt: You reach the glass vault window and spot Owen’s cousin clutching your cold-storage drive:

options.label: Keep the vault sealed until police arrive
options.player_reply_text: Put Rack 2’s drive down slowly. You’re on live backup CCTV.

options.label: Call Owen’s prosecutor to revoke his bail live

nodes.text: The intruder drops the drive and slumps against the glass as sirens approach.
Zero hardware damage! And his burner text directly implicates Owen!
The prosecutor revokes Owen’s bail on the spot—sending marshals back to arrest him for ordering a burglary while out on bond.
Owen just lost his only chance at a plea deal!
You slide the cold-storage drive safely back into Rack 2. Your core AI remains completely untouched.
Titan’s CEO just agreed to $85M cash settlement plus dropping all patent disputes by 5 PM!

nodes.headline: Checkmate In One Day
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Closing Bell Victory — Closing bell chimes across Wall Street.

nodes.text: 4:00 PM · Closing bell chimes across Wall Street. Your company closes at $1.2 billion valuation—zero leaks, zero theft.
We closed up +61% on Day One, Brooke! Every engineer on the floor is crying happy tears!
Forty minutes before the bell was all we needed to save everything we built.
Please tell the judge I only helped Owen because he threatened to expose my grad school thesis.

nodes.transcript: [laughing warmly] "Tessa and Owen are already blaming each other in separate interrogation rooms."

nodes.prompt: CNBC asks for your live closing-bell interview:

options.label: Credit your engineering team & Dev on air
options.player_reply_text: Companies aren’t built by traitors—they’re built by engineers like Dev.

options.label: Announce Dev as your new permanent CTO live

nodes.text: Dev wipes his glasses as the entire HQ erupts in cheers behind the camera.
Best boss in Silicon Valley—hands down!
You announce Dev as Chief Technology Officer live on national TV, sending employee morale through the roof.
Wait—CTO?! I won’t let you down, Brooke!!
Champagne corks pop on the 14th floor—and for once, every person in the room is genuinely loyal.
One last stop tomorrow: the federal indictment hearing for Owen and Tessa.

nodes.headline: Day Of Reckoning
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Federal Verdict — Federal Courthouse.

nodes.text: 11:00 AM · Federal Courthouse. Owen and Tessa receive 11 and 9 years for securities fraud, corporate espionage, and attempted burglary.
It’s official—both guilty on all counts. Plus our $85M settlement from Titan just cleared the bank!
Let’s put half of that straight into our open-source medical AI lab.
I’m sorry, Brooke. You were always smarter than both of us.

nodes.transcript: [proud tone] "Your divorce decree also finalized ten minutes ago. You’re 100% free and 100% in control."

nodes.prompt: Reporters crowd the courthouse steps as you emerge:

options.label: Announce the $40M Medical AI initiative
options.player_reply_text: Today closes a chapter of betrayal. Tomorrow we build AI that saves lives.

options.label: Keep walking with a calm smile to your car

nodes.text: Headlines shift instantly from courtroom scandal to your historic medical AI breakthrough.
Three top hospitals already emailed asking to partner!
Your composed silence speaks louder than any speech—an icon who never needed to shout.
Pure class, Boss. Let’s go build v5.0!
You glance at the Exchange ticker glowing bright green across the avenue.
Ready for the real celebration dinner tonight?

nodes.headline: One Final Horizon
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Version 5.0 — Exactly one year after the morning you woke up in the green room.

nodes.text: 8:50 AM · Exactly one year after the morning you woke up in the green room. Your medical AI just diagnosed its ten-thousandth early cancer case.
Happy IPO-versary, Brooke! Ten thousand lives saved—and not a single backdoor in sight!
Best forty-minute rewind of my entire life, Dev.
Saw your keynote from the prison library. Congratulations.

nodes.transcript: [upbeat voice] "The keynote hall is packed—5,000 developers waiting on you to demo Version 5.0!"

nodes.prompt: Stage lights warm your shoulders as you step to the podium:

options.label: Open with "Never trust an unverified commit"
options.player_reply_text: Good morning! Rule one of AI—and life: always audit who holds your keys.

options.label: Launch Version 5.0 open-source for clinics

nodes.text: Five thousand developers roar with laughter and applause.
Standing ovation before slide two even loaded!!
The screen flashes "v5.0 — FREE FOR PUBLIC HOSPITALS" and the auditorium shakes with cheers.
You just changed global healthcare forever, Boss!
No betrayal, no cell bars, no stolen code—only the brilliance they tried to bury.
They tried to crash my opening bell. Instead, they gave me a standing ovation.

nodes.headline: Unstoppable Code · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: One year after the prison nightmare, Version 5.0 rings the opening bell — unstoppable code, unbreakable founder.
